body: Flag: CLEAN. 127-year-old group; the family split amicably by a Family Settlement Agreement (30-Apr-2024, completed 18-Jul-2024): Adi and Nadir Godrej's side kept the listed Godrej Industries Group (Godrej Industries, Godrej Consumer Products, Godrej Properties, Godrej Agrovet, Astec Lifesciences); Jamshyd Godrej and Smita Godrej Crishna took unlisted Godrej & Boyce and the Vikhroli land bank, with a non-compete and brand-sharing arrangement. Promoters took 64.66% of Godrej Industries under the settlement. No promoter pledging; listed companies have not been used to fund family entities; succession was pre-announced (Pirojsha Godrej to succeed Nadir as GIG chair in Aug-2026). Points to watch: Godrej Industries is a holdco trading at a deep discount to its listed stakes; Godrej Properties raises equity often (QIPs) -- dilution, but at market prices; Astec Lifesciences losses. Lesson: a peaceful, pre-planned split with listed cos untouched is the good template versus litigated feuds (Ambani 2005, Birla-Lodha, TVS 2026). Status Nov-2026: no regulator orders found.

data.good_conduct: amicable 2024 split, no listed-entity value transfer
data.red_flags: holdco discount; frequent GPL equity raises
data.status_2026: Pirojsha Godrej GIG chair from Aug-2026 (announced plan)
